scope: FC07 からの7件の文章review指摘を受けた修正版4 HTML例、fallback renderer、reporter/reviewer契約。実本番HTMLではなく合成例。 The hashed production_workflow.py also includes the FC07 FCT08 author-wrapper binding and fallback attempt-lease corrections; these changes are not part of an approval claim for the synthetic HTML examples. FC07 follow-up F1-F4 revision: event category, existing evidence references, one bounded real reporter revision with re-review and pending fallback on failure, missing-identity continuation; versioned immutable same-attempt output/review/input artifact paths and reconciliation/schema allowlist. Save whitelist scope extension in investigation.save_attempt_artifact is restricted to five anchored, 20-hex, report-stage-only artifact patterns. R2 findings: final review record is bound to the final hash only when genuinely reviewed; unresolved previous findings stay in the exact response sidecar. Missing input identity uses job/launch-derived artifact-storage context without weakening global context validation. Completed fallback resume reads exact report_input path and hash before restoring. R3-F1: completed fallback restore and published readback preserve truthful rejected/changes_requested review with pending report status; approved is accepted only with complete, unavailable only with review_unavailable+pending. No status is promoted to approval. Focused FC07 status-combination tests and fresh independent review are pending. FC08-F1: report publication persists publication evidence and returns stage completion without finalizing the job or selecting incident resolved/in_progress; FC05 terminal reconciliation is sole finalizer. Owner-map scope extension SHA df43283c6e2875d8df4d76609bea49d1136fe38e6a549e23932467f43fb2d066. Focused interruption/failure test and fresh independent review pending.
rendering: HTML source only; browser and print rendering were not performed.

implementation_followup.bounded_revision: One real author invocation receives exact findings, emits a new HTML version, then reviewer is relaunched once. Author failure or repeated findings produces a factual pending/unapproved HTML and proceeds to publication.
implementation_followup.missing_identity: Report body/input preserve supplied incomplete identity and enumerate missing fields. Artifact context derives only from immutable job row/current launch; global _validate_context remains strict.
implementation_followup.immutable_artifacts: Fallback HTML/input/review-input/review-response/review paths use content-hash versions within the same attempt. Result path remains stable. save_attempt_artifact whitelist now allows only those five hash-versioned names for report stage; all other stages retain their fixed allowlists.
implementation_followup.review_binding: Each raw reviewer result stays bound to the HTML path/hash it reviewed. A newly generated final fallback receives a separate unavailable record bound to the final hash.
implementation_followup.resume: Resume loads exact result.report_input path/hash, validates same job/attempt fixed versioned name, fallback schema/identity/storage identity, output path/hash, and review binding.
